extDescription.message: Block distracting sites with a blocklist or allowlist, a Pomodoro timer, and password or timer locks.

notifyWork.message: Work: $1 min. Distracting sites are blocked.

errNoDomain.message: This page has no domain to add.

errTimerRange.message: Timer must be a whole number from 1 to 1440 minutes.

errTimerLocked.message: Timer is running. Settings are locked until it ends.

errTimerExtendOnly.message: A running timer can only be extended.

errTimerAllowlistEmpty.message: The allowlist is empty, so a lock timer would block every website. Add sites first.

errTimerBlocklistEmpty.message: The blocklist is empty, so a lock timer would block nothing. Add sites first.

errPasswordShort.message: Password must be at least 4 characters.

errPomodoroEmptyList.message: Add sites to block during work, or choose to use the main rules.

errPomodoroMainEmpty.message: The main blocklist is empty, so nothing would be blocked during work.

errPomodoroField.message: $1 must be a whole number from $2 to $3.

errNoResponse.message: No response from the extension. Try reopening this page.

pomo_cycles.message: Work sessions before a long break

bannerLocked.message: Lock timer running. Settings are locked for

hintMode.message: Blocklist blocks only the sites listed. Allowlist allows only the sites listed and blocks everything else.

hintBlocklist.message: One domain per line. Subdomains are included: youtube.com also blocks m.youtube.com.

hintAllowlist.message: Used only in allowlist mode. If it is empty, every website is blocked.

hintPomodoro.message: Work and break sessions repeat until you stop them. Sites are blocked only during work.

hintPomoApply.message: Changes apply to the next run. Stopping needs the password, if one is set.

passwordIsSet.message: A password is set. It is needed to turn focus off, stop a Pomodoro, change the password, or loosen the main rules.

passwordNotSet.message: No password. Anyone can change settings.

hintLockTimer.message: Blocks with the main mode and lists and prevents loosening the blocking, stopping Pomodoro, or changing the password until it ends. It can only be extended.

confirmEmptyAllowlist.message: The allowlist is empty, so every website will be blocked. Continue?

confirmTimer.message: Start a lock timer for $1 min? Blocking follows the main mode and lists. This cannot be stopped early.

reasonFocus.message: is blocked while focus is on.

reasonTimer.message: is blocked until the lock timer ends.

reasonPomodoro.message: is blocked during this Pomodoro work session.

announceFree.message: This site is not blocked anymore.

dlgUnlockText.message: This change loosens the blocking, so it needs your password.

dlgSetPasswordText.message: You will need it to turn focus off, unblock sites or stop a Pomodoro. There is no recovery if you forget it.

dlgRemovePasswordText.message: Anyone will be able to change settings and turn focus off.
